nodes.name: Fetch Job Listings
nodes.notes: Free, no-auth job board API. Swap for RemoteOK, Adzuna, or any other job API/RSS feed if you prefer.

nodes.name: Score Match with AI
nodes.notes: Requires an 'HTTP Header Auth' credential named e.g. 'Groq API' with Header Name = Authorization and Header Value = Bearer YOUR_GROQ_API_KEY. Set up under n8n Credentials -- do NOT hardcode the key in this node.

nodes.name: Good Match?
nodes.notes: EDIT ME: change 65 to your preferred minimum match score (0-100). 65 was validated as a working default.

nodes.name: Send Slack Alert
